question: Approve the Paseo peer sender-label POC outcome, scope, non-goals, budget and stop condition for implementation?

artifacts.summary: POC: a Paseo plugin gives agent-to-agent messages a sender label the receiver can verify; a forged label via plain send_agent_prompt fails the check; a Captain message is not reported as a peer. Stop if Paseo offers no checkable label (negative result is valid).
